name: 🍲 Soup & Sammie Night
what: Hot soup with crispy turkey and cheddar melts for dunking.
extras: peppered turkey or deli ham, parmesan for the soup

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Soup into a pot on medium-low.
Butter one side of every slice of bread.
Build: buttered side out, cheese, turkey, cheese.
Cook in a skillet on medium-low with a lid until golden and melty.

key: Medium-low heat and a lid, so the cheese melts before the bread burns.
done: Bread is golden and the cheese is oozing.
plan_b: Out of soup? Melts with apple slices or carrots.
